announceInChat.name: Announce players in chat

queueDuringScene.name: Queue during a dialog scene
queueDuringScene.hint: What happens to the floating queue while a dialog scene is on screen
queueDuringScene.top: Collapse to the top of the screen (scene panel)

enableSounds.name: 🔊 Enable priority sounds
enableSounds.hint: Play a sound when the queue priority changes

soundOnlyForSelf.name: 🎵 Sounds for myself only
soundOnlyForSelf.hint: If enabled, you only hear your own sounds

enableLowPrioritySound.name: 🟢 Low priority sound (!)
enableLowPrioritySound.hint: Play a sound for low priority

enableMediumPrioritySound.name: 🟡 Medium priority sound (!!)
enableMediumPrioritySound.hint: Play a sound for medium priority

enableHighPrioritySound.name: 🔴 High priority sound (!!!)
enableHighPrioritySound.hint: Play a sound for high priority

testSounds.name: 🎮 Test sounds
testSounds.label: Open sound test
testSounds.hint: Check how each priority sounds with your current settings

darkTheme.name: 🌙 Dark theme
darkTheme.hint: Force a dark look for the queue window. By default the window follows the Foundry color scheme (light or dark)

nameplateImage.name: 🎭 Character nameplate
nameplateImage.hint: Pick an image from the assets/dialog name lables/ folder, or leave empty for the default look.

liteMode.name: 🪶 Lite mode for dialog scenes
liteMode.hint: For weak computers: on your screen no particles, visual effects, parallax or camera zoom are drawn, and blur behind panels is removed. Background and portraits stay. Other players and the GM still see the scene normally

effectFilters.name: 🎚️ Dialog scene effects: fine tuning
effectFilters.label: Configure effects
effectFilters.hint: Choose which background, particle and portrait effects this screen does not draw, and set a ceiling for the particle intensity. Effects are grouped by how heavy they are. Applies while "Lite mode" is off. Other players and the GM see the scene as usual

parallaxEnabled.name: 🎥 Background parallax
parallaxEnabled.hint: Smooth background shift as the mouse moves in the dialog scene

parallaxDepth.name: 🎥 Parallax depth
parallaxDepth.hint: How far the background shifts with the mouse (0 - no shift, 100 - maximum)

cameraEnabled.name: Virtual Camera
cameraEnabled.hint: Smooth camera zoom toward the active speaker

cameraDoF.name: Depth of Field
cameraDoF.hint: Stronger blur on inactive characters when camera is active

thumbnailFolder.name: Preset thumbnail folder
thumbnailFolder.hint: Where thumbnails of dialog scene presets are saved. Empty = a separate folder inside the world. Any folder in Data works, including one inside a module, so the thumbnails travel with it. Existing thumbnails keep working after a change; to rebuild them in the new place use "Regenerate all" in the Presets tab menu.

fxFilters.title: Scene effects: what to draw
fxFilters.hint: Checked effects are not drawn on your screen. Other players and the GM see the scene as usual and the scene state does not change. The groups are an estimate based on the techniques used, not measurements.

tierHints.heavy: SVG filters, cracks, shards, many large layers
tierHints.medium: several animated layers, blending, blurred copies
tierHints.light: static colour grading and a layer or two

fxFilters.particleMaxHint: The same slider as the GM's "Particle intensity", but yours: if the GM sets more, your screen shows no more than this. Applies to every particle type. 20 means no limit.

soundTest.title: Priority Sound Test
soundTest.hint: Click a priority to hear its sound with your current settings

particlesLayer.front: Particles in front of characters (click: mixed)
particlesLayer.mix: Particles mixed: some behind, some in front (click: behind)
